description: This PHP script retrieves configuration templates or interface information related to system request management types in the TestLink project. It initializes the page, processes request parameters, interacts with the tlReqMgrSystem class, and outputs JSON with the retrieved configuration or error messages.

classes.name: tlReqMgrSystem
classes.description: A class responsible for managing request types and their configurations within the TestLink system.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Retrieves available request management system types.

methods.name: getImplementationForType
methods.description: Returns the implementation class name for a given request type.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Static method of the implementation class that returns the configuration template.
